title: RAG Document Q&A Assistant
summary: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline using Sentence-Transformers and FAISS vector indexing with strict citation grounding and similarity thresholds to mitigate LLM hallucinations.
arch: Documents (.pdf / .txt) -> Overlapping Semantic Chunking -> all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Embeddings -> FAISS Inner-Product Index -> Similarity Threshold Filter -> Citation-Grounded Prompt
details: Eliminates out-of-context hallucinations by enforcing minimum cosine similarity gates and mandatory [doc_id | chunk] source citations in every generated answer.

title: Fake News Detection Pipeline
summary: Engineered an end-to-end NLP text classification pipeline using NLTK for pre-processing, tokenization, and feature engineering. Optimized classifier architectures via hyperparameter tuning to achieve 95% accuracy.
arch: Raw News Corpus -> Regex Cleaning & Stopword Removal (NLTK) -> WordNet Lemmatization -> Sublinear TF-IDF (1,2-grams) -> 5-Fold GridSearchCV -> Passive-Aggressive / Logistic Classifier (95% Acc)
details: Designed to filter misinformation at scale by combining linguistic pre-processing with n-gram TF-IDF features and regularized classifiers evaluated via stratified cross-validation.

title: Statistical Forecasting of Energy Data
summary: Engineered a comparative time-series forecasting pipeline analyzing 15 years of state energy data. Executed extensive EDA and evaluated AR, MA, ARIMA, and SARIMA models using RMSE and MAPE metrics.
arch: 15-Year State Energy Dataset -> Missing Value Imputation & Stationarity Tests (ADF) -> Seasonal Decomposition -> AR / MA / ARIMA / SARIMA Benchmark -> RMSE & MAPE Selection
details: Modeled long-term seasonal and trend components across 15 years of state power consumption data, identifying SARIMA(1,1,1)(1,1,1,12) configurations that minimized out-of-sample RMSE and MAPE.
